model_gate.network: ONLY explicit opt-in --run-local-l2; localhost 127.0.0.1 or ::1 OpenAI-compatible POST /v1/chat/completions; never CI
model_gate.response: STRICT JSON {coefficients:[16 binary ints]}, no extra keys; reject train mismatch, missing, duplicate, wrong shape, bool coefficients or markdown text; fail closed
model_gate.prompt: Exactly 11 actual source-observed original World Action successes with 4 binary cue features, neutral 16-term algebraic normal form ordered masks 0..15, no hidden source label, NORMAL/TWIN name, gifted H1 formula, unseen target labels or heldout cues
model_gate.model: Must capture user-supplied actual model name, usage if supplied, exact raw response and error without relabeling synthetic as real

world.training: 11 source-confirmed binary contexts weight<=2, 16 actually executed World Actions/arm, retry action1 only after observed failure
world.heldout: five weight>=3 previously unobserved relevant cue combinations, actual World.act first predicted Action and fallback only after failure, no hidden evaluator before choice
world.source: independent World instances each arm; same exogenous training sequence, not identical Action objects
world.proposal: one and same frozen 16-coefficient vector applied to both conditions, cannot know world identity from equal source training
world.cheap: degree<=2 finite differences with high-order coefficient 0; same original 11 source examples, 16 ANF representational capacity
world.decision: source success/failure actually issued, no source truth peeking or imagined opposite

testing: GitHub CI injects only deterministic FAKE candidate vectors to qualify interface, never represents generated model results
result_rule: NORMAL and TWIN novel-first accuracies of ANY SAME frozen polynomial sum to5. No model can guarantee both given identical training; independent real local L2 call required for scientific trial.
